categories.observation: Top-level categories are help-and-support, general, communities, osmf, site-feedback, migration; no commercial-work or jobs category exists (TASK-179416476112).

searches.note: hits were discussions about organised editing, shops and Uber edits, not buyer requests

candidates.buyer: FMC (user FMC-Henri), project for the City of Berlin
candidates.requested_outcome: paid checking and completion of cycling and street infrastructure in OSM along the Berlin Rad-Ergaenzungsnetz (~1,500 km; ~2,100 km with main roads), processed in TILDA Radverkehr
quotes: Wir suchen nun weitere Hilfe aus der Community für bezahlte Mapping-Aufgaben: Radinfrastruktur in Berlin erfassen
Wir suchen auch noch eine Person, welche mit dem Fahrrad durch Berlin fährt und 360° Bilder erstellt.
candidates.compensation: paid, amount not read (formal Organized Editing documentation not fetched)
reject_reasons: deliverable is live edits to the OSM database, requiring an accountable OSM account under the Organised Editing Guidelines; no authorized account and agents must not create one
work needs local knowledge/imagery interpretation inside OSM editors, not an offline conversion of public inputs
application route requires contacting the buyer; outgoing contact not implemented
partly requires physical presence (360-degree bicycle imagery)

conclusion: The openly readable OSM community has no commercial-work category; the single recent paid request is live organised mapping, not an offline deliverable. No dataset or sample was produced, per mission rules.
